purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Uttar Pradesh has a first-party BhuNaksha cadastral viewer and Bhulekh land-record/digitization services. The live viewer exposes public hierarchy and plot routes, but the city-named Pratapgarh village records were marked without map data; the city extent was zero and anonymous point/plot responses were empty. No polygon was retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: Local/state custody is evidenced by the Government of Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha viewer, Bhulekh dashboard and Pratapgarh district administration portal. The Bhulekh dashboard specifically reports Pratapgarh tehsil linked Bhunaksha villages and mapsheet digitization. This is registry/map-program evidence, not proof of an open city parcel feature service.

attempts.result: Point request at exact [25.9152575987023,81.98769878421] and plot-number request both returned empty JSON objects. This was recorded as an unusable response, not citywide absence.

attempts.result: Official dashboard and district portal were inspected; Pratapgarh tehsil cadastral-map linkage and local government custody were evidenced. No geometry endpoint was inferred from dashboard prose.

geometryDecision.details: No safe full parcel polygon and no verified stable native parcel identity were obtained. No exact-point hit or miss was used to infer coverage.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha, Bhulekh cadastral digitization dashboard, Bhulekh portal and Pratapgarh district administration sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official hierarchy, public map routes, city-named village no-data flags, zero extent and empty anonymous plot responses; no parcel geometry, schema or CRS.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel or survey identifier
remainingUncertainty: Coverage may vary by revenue village and the city-named records may be administrative/no-map entries. The service may expose geometry through another official village code or after map-data publication; this review did not infer absence from the zero extent or exact-point miss.
